How do I debounce a function in TypeScript?

A debounce delays a call until input settles. The delay is ttt ms.

typescript
function debounce(fn: () => void, ms: number) {
  let id: number | undefined;
  return () => { clearTimeout(id); id = setTimeout(fn, ms); };
}
OptionDefault
ms300
